commentary.text: 90+9' The match has just finished.
90+8' Cristian Rivero (Valencia) is shown a red card even though he is not on the pitch. Unsporting behavior says the referee.
90+7' Juan Antonio Iglesias Sanchez (Getafe) breaks into the box and goes over after a challenge from an opposition player, but the ref signals NO penalty!
90+7' Stole Dimitrievski pulls off a run-of-the-mill save from a header by Mauro Arambarri (Getafe) after a cross from the side.
90+6' Luis Milla (Getafe) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.
90+6' Diego Rico (Getafe) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. Getafe have a corner.
90+3' Juanmi (Getafe) is penalised for a foul. Isidro Diaz had a clear view and blows his whistle.
90+1' The resulting corner from Luis Milla (Getafe) is cleared.
90+1' There will be a minimum of 6 min. of added time.
90+1' Carlos Corberan is stunned as referee Isidro Diaz shows him a yellow card. What was that for?
87' Substitution. Lucas Beltran did his best and is replaced by Rubo (Valencia).
87' That's the end of the game for Filip Ugrinic, who is replaced by Javi Guerra (Valencia).
86' The referee demonstrates he won't tolerate this behaviour. Filip Ugrinic (Valencia) is given a yellow card.
85' Jose Bordalas Jimenez prepares a substitution. Mario Martin is replaced by Coba da Costa (Getafe).
85' It will be a substitution. Alejandro Mestanza (Getafe) is ready to enter the pitch as Javier Munoz walks off.
84' 0 - 1 GOAL! Jose Gaya (Valencia) collects a pass and from inside the box he lifts the ball over David Soria, who was off his line. What a finish that is! 0:1.
82' The attendance for today's match is 8361.
81' Jose Gaya (Valencia) has received a yellow card for his foul.
80' Umar Sadiq (Valencia) latches on to a cross on the edge of the box and fires a shot at goal, but his effort was blocked by one of the defenders.
79' Valencia take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
78' Isidro Diaz blows the whistle, Filip Ugrinic (Valencia) is penalised for a foul.
73' Pepelu (Valencia) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Isidro Diaz no option but to blow his whistle.
72' A substitution has been made. Adrian Liso goes off and Juanmi (Getafe) comes on.
71' The ball rebounds to Javier Munoz (Getafe) inside the box after a goalmouth scramble, but he whips the ball high over bar.
68' Yellow card. Adrian Liso (Getafe) goes into the referee's book after a bad challenge.
67' Dimitri Foulquier (Valencia) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Isidro Diaz who sees an offensive foul.
63' Getafe take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

63' Javier Munoz (Getafe) sees an unmarked teammate and attempts to send him a low pass. However, one of the defenders reads the game perfectly and averts the danger. The referee signals a corner kick to Getafe.
63' What was Umar Sadiq (Valencia) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
61' Carlos Corberan has decided to substitute Hugo Duro and he is replaced by Umar Sadiq (Valencia).
61' The manager makes a subsitution with Diego Lopez (Valencia) coming on for Arnaut Danjuma.
60' A cross from a corner kick by Valencia is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.

59' Arnaut Danjuma (Valencia) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat. Valencia win a corner.
58' Martin Satriano (Getafe) receives a sweet pass inside the box, but his effort on goal is blocked by the defender.
57' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Getafe comes to nothing.
56' Arnaut Danjuma (Valencia) easily beats an opponent inside the box and goes for goal, but his effort flies just wide of the left post.
56' Getafe have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
54' Flag up against Martin Satriano (Getafe). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
51' Domingos Duarte (Getafe) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
48' The defence had a hard time blocking out the strike from Mario Martin (Getafe). He didn't hesitate and finished from outside the box right after he had received a pass from his teammate.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+3' Isidro Diaz has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+1' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.
45' Arnaut Danjuma (Valencia) gets into a promising shooting position on the edge of the box after a nice pass, but his effort is deflected onto the post by one of the defenders.
42' Excellent touch by Filip Ugrinic (Valencia)! He latches on to a precise pass on the edge of the box and produces a shot goalwards which goes way wide of the left post.
41' Isidro Diaz blows his whistle. Martin Satriano (Getafe) commits a foul after dangerous play.

40' Juan Antonio Iglesias Sanchez (Getafe) reacts well and displays good awareness inside the box to get on the end of the corner kick. He fails to direct the ball into the net as it flies narrowly wide of the left post.
39' The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Getafe.

38' Juan Antonio Iglesias Sanchez (Getafe) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players. The linesman makes the right call and Getafe will have a corner.
38' A dangerous looking corner kick from Javier Munoz (Getafe) is cleared to safety by the defence.
37' Adrian Liso (Getafe) delivers a low pass into the box which is intercepted.
36' Luis Rioja (Valencia) sends a teasing cross into the area, but David Soria intercepts the ball.
33' Javier Munoz (Getafe) fires a low volley towards the right side of the goal from the edge of the penalty box, but the goalkeeper pulls off a brilliant save.
31' The resulting set piece from Getafe is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
30' Cesar Tarrega is being substituted because of an injury. Carlos Corberan sends Baptiste Santamaria (Valencia) on the pitch.

29' Diego Rico (Getafe) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. The referee points to the corner flag and Getafe will take a corner.

26' Mario Martin (Getafe) attempts to score as he rises near the penalty spot and heads the ball to the middle of the goal. Stole Dimitrievski pulls off a comfortable save to stop the ball from hitting the net.
25' Arnaut Danjuma (Valencia) commits a foul and Isidro Diaz immediately signals a free kick.
19' Hugo Duro (Valencia) does well to dispossess the attacker with a slide tackle, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
18' Jose Copete (Valencia) was too forceful with his tackle and Isidro Diaz interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
18' A cross from a corner kick by Valencia is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
16' Luis Milla (Getafe) takes the corner, but he overhits it and none of his teammates are able to reach the ball.

14' Adrian Liso (Getafe) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal. Getafe force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.

13' Martin Satriano (Getafe) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Isidro Diaz with no other option than to blow for a foul.
12' A pass by Luis Rioja (Valencia) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
11' Arnaut Danjuma (Valencia) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
6' A player from Valencia commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.

3' Javier Munoz (Getafe) meets a delivery on the edge of the penalty area and shoots towards the top of the net. He didn't put enough power into the effort, though, and Stole Dimitrievski produces an easy save.
